purpose: Test the instrument. 97 passing tests mean nothing unless a broken implementation makes them fail; a test that passes either way is the exact defect that let c020's end-turn veto ship while never firing.
method: Apply a targeted source mutation, run the full c021 suite, restore. A mutant that SURVIVES is a defect the suite cannot see.

mutants.note: The one real hole this found. Deleting the mask left all 97 tests green, so the load-bearing legality guarantee was untested in pytest -- an unmasked policy can sample an illegal action, and every gradient through that mass is wrong. Two tests added: illegal actions must carry exactly zero probability even when an illegal option holds the dominant logit, and 30 sampled actions under a sparse mask must all be legal. Now killed.

mutants.mutation: every card treated as uncapped energy

caveat: 11 hand-chosen mutants over the components this contract's claims rest on. It is evidence the suite detects THESE defect classes, not proof it detects all of them. Whole-file mutation coverage was not run.
